function.name: set_alarm
function.description: Set an alarm for a specific time. The time can be specified in various formats, including 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' for specific dates, 'HH:MM:SS' or 'HH:MM' for time only, and 'HH:MM AM/PM' for 12-hour format. purpose.description: The purpose of the alarm, such as 'wake up' or 'meeting'.

volume.description: The volume level to play the song at, ranging from 0 (mute) to 100 (maximum volume).
